# fswitcher: cmd+tab for multiple displays, grouped by screen
## Channel: forma labs
0 likes

### Description
4 views
Posted: 2026-11-04
fswitcher.app

fswitcher is a cmd+tab replacement for Mac built for multiple displays. It intentionally keeps the same cmd+tab behavior, looks and feels like the native switcher, and allows you to show either app or window tiles.

The switcher appears on each display, and switching only affects the screen you choose. Windowless apps move to the bottom row for less clutter, which you can access with the control key. Hidden apps show dimmed, and minimized apps move out of the way. The same shortcuts that work on the native switcher also work on fswitcher. [...] Live previews can show as thumbnails, or full-screen. Opt+` lets you cycle through all windows of the same app, and Instant Switching allows you to switch through apps quickly by using the right command key + the first letter of the app.
